map.3 级和 4 级怎么区分更准？: How to distinguish grade 3 from grade 4 more accurately?
map.关键在施加阻力的方式：3 级能抗重力完成全范围活动但不能抗任何外加阻力；4 级能: The key lies in how resistance is applied: grade 3 achieves the full range against gravity but cannot resist any added resistance; grade 4 resists some resistance but less than normal. In practice, give resistance compared with the examiner's same-named muscle group, and apply it in the middle portion of the joint range (not the start or end), because leverage and muscle tone at the ends mislead interpretation. Values between two grades are marked with + or -, but before-and-after assessments of the same patient must be performed by the same examiner to reduce bias.
